refnamediv.refpurpose: Structure of function pointers for a SilikoInput object

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: A SilikoInputVTable is one of two components used to construct a SilikoInput. The SilikoInputVTable is a table of functions used to interact with the other component, a void pointer to a user-defined state object for the source.

The advance pointer points to a function that accepts the state object (as a void pointer) and advances the state object to the next character if there are further characters to read from the input. The function must return true if there are further characters to read, and must return false if the input source is exhausted.

The getCharacter pointer points to a function that takes the state object (as a void pointer) and returns the current character from the source if the source is not exhausted, and returns '\0' if the source is exhausted. The function must be idempotent until the advance function is called on the state object.

The destroy pointer points to a function that takes the state object, and frees up any resources used by the state object. The function must also take care of deallocating the state object itself if applicable.
